description: Reconcile a payment processor payout (the deposit that reached the bank) to the transactions it should settle. Send the payout amount and the lines: charges, refunds, fees, disputes and adjustments, each with its signed effect on the payout. Get back the totals per type, the payout the lines add up to, the gap, and the lines that could explain a gap: a line not in this payout, a line whose sign looks reversed, a whole type left out (fees billed separately), two lines left out, or a line missing from your list, plus lines that look like duplicates. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/payout-reconciliation). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. a payout reference (your own text, up to 6 digits in a row; echoed).

lines.description: The transactions you expect in this payout (up to 200).

amount.description: Effect on the payout, signed: charges positive, refunds negative, fees negative (positive for a fee credit), disputes negative when funds are taken and positive when returned, adjustments either sign. Not 0.

ref.description: Optional transaction or order reference (your own text, up to 6 digits in a row, so long all-digit processor ids are refused: send their last 6 digits; used to spot duplicates).

type.description: charge, refund, fee, dispute or adjustment.

payout_amount.description: The payout amount the processor sent to the bank (negative if it took money from the bank).

name: payout_reconciliation
title: Processor Payout Reconciliation
